label: requires a specific exception to a writing barrier
explanation: The court’s exception required a promise to sign a compliant writing; a general promise to delay foreclosure did not satisfy it.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 372–375. Open assigned page 372.
